title: First Tor vanishes for the second syzygy over two variables
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x_0,x_1], and let k as an S-module mean restriction of scalars along constant coefficient. Use Tor as in [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. Let F_0 and F_1 be S-modules in the ring universe with specified finite bases, q_0:F_0 to M a surjective S-linear map, and q_1:F_1 to ker(q_0) a surjective S-linear map. M may have a different universe. Then Tor_1^S(ker(q_1),k) has subsingleton carrier. No grading assumptions are required.

proof.text: Replace M by F_0/ker(q_0) via the first isomorphism theorem when its universe differs. The maps yield two short exact sequences with free middle modules. The natural-isomorphism clause of [lem-sc-p1-tor-dimension-shifting] identifies Tor_1(ker(q_1),k) with Tor_3(M,k).

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-tor-symmetry] to replace Tor_3(M,k) by Tor_3(k,M).

proof.text: The exact free Koszul complex in [lem-sc-p1-koszul-resolution] resolves S/(X_0,X_1) in degrees 0,1,2. The quotient is the constant-coefficient S-module k: constant coefficient is surjective, and its kernel is the variable ideal because each nonconstant monomial is divisible by a variable. Package the Koszul complex as a projective resolution. By [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules], Tor_3(k,M) is its third homology after tensoring with M. There is no degree-three term, hence this homology is zero.

theorem second_syzygy_tor_vanishes {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) M]
    (F₀ F₁ : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))
    (r₀ r₁ : ℕ)
    (b₀ : Module.Basis (Fin r₀) (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) F₀)
    (b₁ : Module.Basis (Fin r₁) (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) F₁)
    (q₀ : F₀ →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] M) (hq₀ : Function.Surjective q₀)
    (q₁ : F₁ →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] q₀.ker) (hq₁ : Function.Surjective q₁) :
    Subsingleton (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) 1).obj
      (ModuleCat.of (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) q₁.ker)).obj
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        (MvPolynomial.constantCoeff : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* k)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of k k)))
